work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. CXXIII 42583 and synopsis 42584–42586 follow previous dating 42565–42569; addressee 42588–42591 and Urban self-protocol 42593–42597 identify a new commission. Its narrative continues 42615→42627 across title source note 42617. The edition deliberately abbreviates the recalled prior grant at 42634 with etc., keyed to 42674 Reliqua prout in constitutione praecedenti; no omitted wording is reconstructed. The surviving operative appointment 42635–42647 and sections 2–3 remain in order, and full/short dating 42680–42684 closes this source expression before CXXIV 42687. Both source notes remain with their markers. The literal etc.42634 and note42674 leave a jump in the recalled earlier grant/formula before plenitudine paribus42635; current substantive appointment42635–42647, obedience mandate42648–42661 and derogation42662–42672 are printed. Admission concerns that complete printed present commission, not reconstructed prior-grant wording.
